title: Tokyo 2015: archived call for presentations
body:
Archived deadline notice

The following wording is preserved from the historical submission page. It is not an invitation to submit a proposal today.

WE ARE NO LONGER ACCEPTING PRESENTATION SUBMISSIONS. VOTING IS NOW CLOSED.

The former application let speakers manage their own submissions. Submission, editing and deletion actions are closed in this archive.

Browse the Tokyo 2015 archive
description: Historical Tokyo 2015 guidance. Submissions, voting and review actions are closed.
archiveNotice: Historical Tokyo 2015 archive. All submission, voting and review actions for this page are closed. Instructions and deadlines below are retained only for reference.
